summary: Kanzhun Limited filed a Form 6-K attaching a Hong Kong Next Day Disclosure Return (US equivalent: Form 4/8-K share-change notice) dated September 11, 2026, covering equity movements. The issuer reported option exercises totaling 3,641,674 Class A ordinary shares on September 8-10, 2026 at USD 0.50-1.7474 per share, lifting issued shares to 826,138,271 from 822,496,597. It also listed 8,148,142 shares repurchased in May-June 2026 at roughly USD 6.67-7.25, not yet cancelled. No board recommendation or advisor named. This is routine share-status reporting; watch buyback cancellation timing and dilution from further option exercises.
